feedback: The final contradiction makes the accusation reasonably solvable before voting, using a recording rather than a confession-only revelation. Several characters sound individually pressured: Monet keeps calculating wages, Chip wants his workbench intact, and Al worries about the person waiting at home. Those moments make the crowded cast feel human. Later speeches often restate documentary exclusions rather than develop the room's conflict. The physical distinctions are useful, especially the wood model, real bottle, bare glass, and clean flavoring sample. Some evidence feels designed to rebut hypothetical alternatives the reader has not seriously proposed. Robin's ownership card is also less explicit than the staff query about what she actually learned of the poison, so the inference relies heavily on her location lie. Offstage staff are clearly declared nonselectable, and their accounts are usable without needing a missing participant. The unused photographer receipt introduces a role outside the attending cast, but does not prevent the core deduction.
